props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state of the dialog when it is initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control its open state.

props.name: modal
props.description:
The modality of the dialog. When `true`, `DialogOverlay` paints its
tap-blocking backdrop and the content confines assistive tech via
`exclusiveFocus`.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the dialog. Can be bound as `v-model:open`.
